changeSet.author: Furkhan
changeSet.comment: Store immutable attachment bytes separately from recipient-specific outbox JSON.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE email_notification_attachment_snapshot ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, file_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, content_type VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, content BYTEA NOT NULL, file_size BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT chk_email_attachment_snapshot_size CHECK (file_size > 0 AND file_size <= 26214400) );
CREATE INDEX idx_email_attachment_snapshot_created ON email_notification_attachment_snapshot (created_at);
